R1370_countermodel_boundary_review.countermodel: Keep one Task Atom identity, one authoritative Markdown Carrier at its owning Scope's Plan root, one Atom Scope and Claim Scope, and one Claim. A replacement Standard Delivery rule reads one authoritative Task membership binding and derives direct CONTAINS/IS_CONTAINED_BY connections to two Epics. The membership facts have one owner; generated Epic views are not independently editable truths. Both Epics remain acyclic planning collections within the same owning Scope.

preserved_core.boundary: Atom Collections organize Atoms without creating Scope boundaries; two Epic memberships do not create two Task Scope owners.
Epic membership remains Delivery-derived CONTAINS/IS_CONTAINED_BY, not independent authored relation declarations.
Containment remains in the Structural Entity containment domain, distinct from Scope Unit structural_parent.
The two membership edges introduce no containment cycle.
Each organizing Epic identity remains independent of its member Task.
The Task's one governed Claim retains one authoritative owner.
Each represented Epic Directory Carrier still carries exactly one Structural Entity Revision; the Task's shared membership does not duplicate a Carrier.
Recursive membership still equals transitive closure of the complete direct containment graph.
The sole authoritative Task membership binding and all persistent sources remain outside Runtime State.
The current D308 is Journal append-only serialization; no admitted Journal Record is edited.

preserved_additional_choice.boundary: Even the existing Standard one-authoritative-Markdown-Carrier choice can be retained; two Epic memberships do not require two Task Carriers.

changed_standard_choice.boundary: Replace nearest-ancestor-directory membership derivation with a different single-source Delivery derivation; this is explicitly a hypothetical Standard alternative, not permission for a live variation.
